_help: qrg.config.json: the one project-specific file. All paths are relative to this file's folder. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. See qrg_kit/README.md for every key.
author: Change Management
_sets_help: One set = one audience (a unit plus a role). id: letters, digits, hyphens. prefix: starts every file name. unitLine: under the title. footerTag: in the footer. dir: guide files and screenshots. out: where the Word files go. assetKey: asset folder name before NN. sendFolder: folder name under the send folder.
_qa_help: names: people's first and last names that must never appear in a guide (or one per line in qa_names.txt). dictionary: approved product names, acronyms, and UI labels for offline proofing (or one per line in qa_dictionary.txt). idPatterns: regex sources for internal tracking IDs (the example matches ABC-123 style ticket IDs). styleAllow: exact phrases the style check should skip (for example a field label that really says Grey). extraBanned: [{label, pattern, flags}] for project words to keep out (internal system names, client code names). sessionWords: a regex source that replaces the built-in list of session and build words.
_review_help: dir: locks, renders, and OK List sheets. sendDir: local folder for clean-named copies to move by hand. sendKeepNumber: true keeps the NN in send names.
